cases.prompt: Serve this scripted ResNet50 .pt on Triton with dynamic batching.
expected_behavior: Build a config.pbtxt with platform: pytorch_libtorch, max_batch_size, dynamic_batching block, instance_group KIND_GPU
cases.ground_truth: Build a config.pbtxt with platform: pytorch_libtorch, max_batch_size, dynamic_batching block, instance_group KIND_GPU.

cases.prompt: Triton logs: unable to find '/models/foo/1/model.pt' for model instance 'foo'.
expected_behavior: Place model.pt at 1/model.pt or set default_model_filename
cases.ground_truth: Place model.pt at 1/model.pt or set default_model_filename.

cases.prompt: Set up sequence batching with state on TorchScript.
expected_behavior: Use NAMED_INDEX naming (INPUT__0, OUTPUT__0) for every input and output
Add a sequence_batching block to config.pbtxt
Add a control_input block listing only the controls the model needs (START, END, CORRID, READY as applicable)
cases.ground_truth: NAMED_INDEX naming, sequence_batching block, control_input block.

cases.prompt: Export a PyTorch model to PT2 for GPU serving on Triton.
expected_behavior: Give the torch.export + Dim recipe with .cuda() on model and sample, package, and deploy with KIND_GPU
cases.ground_truth: Give the torch.export + Dim recipe with .cuda() on model and sample, package, and deploy with KIND_GPU.

cases.prompt: My PT2 fails when batch > 1. What's wrong?
expected_behavior: Archive was exported without torch.export.Dim on batch
Re-export with dynamic batch dim >= max_batch_size
cases.ground_truth: Archive was exported without torch.export.Dim on batch.

cases.prompt: Triton says Incorrect device passed to aoti_runner_cpu.
expected_behavior: PT2 archive was exported on wrong device
Re-export on target device
cases.ground_truth: PT2 archive was exported on wrong device.

cases.prompt: What do I name inputs in a PT2 config.pbtxt?
expected_behavior: Either call-spec names (ARGS[0], KWARGS[k]) or ordinals (INPUT__0)
Both work
cases.ground_truth: Either call-spec names (ARGS[0], KWARGS[k]) or ordinals (INPUT__0).

cases.prompt: Should I use TorchScript or PT2 for my new model?
expected_behavior: Explain: PT2 is the forward path if torch.export works for the model; TorchScript is legacy but widely compatible
cases.ground_truth: Explain: PT2 is the forward path if torch.export works for the model; TorchScript is legacy but widely compatible.
